name: simplyutils
description: Everyday developer and text tools from SimplyUtils.

interface.longDescription: Everyday developer and text tools: format JSON, make QR codes, convert units, generate passwords and UUIDs, hash text, encode or decode Base64, test regex, convert timestamps and count words. SimplyUtils connects to 10 read-only tools through its hosted MCP server. Inputs are processed on SimplyUtils infrastructure; according to the operator, tool inputs and results are not stored by the MCP server. The server computes results without AI calls or external lookups. QR codes are static, UUIDs are version 4, and regular expressions use JavaScript syntax. Tool results include links to the matching SimplyUtils web utility. Operated by Memegician LLC.
defaultPrompt: Format this JSON with sorted keys: {"b":2,"a":1}
Create a QR code for https://simplyutils.com

prompts: Pretty-print this JSON with two-space indentation and alphabetically sorted keys: {"b":2,"a":1}
Create a QR code for https://simplyutils.com
Find every sequence of digits in "Order 12 and 345" using a JavaScript regex.

positive.description: Format valid JSON with sorted keys. No setup or attachments.
positive.prompt: Pretty-print this JSON with two-space indentation and alphabetically sorted keys: {"b":2,"a":1}
positive.expected_behavior: Call format_json with json={"b":2,"a":1}, indent="2", sortKeys=true. Return valid formatted JSON with a before b and unchanged values.

positive.description: Generate a static QR image from a public website URL.
positive.prompt: Create a QR code for https://simplyutils.com
positive.expected_behavior: Call generate_qr_code with text="https://simplyutils.com". Display the returned PNG where supported and offer the returned SVG; do not claim the QR was uploaded or saved remotely.

positive.description: Convert a known length using a numeric string input.
positive.expected_behavior: Call convert_units with value="5", category="length", from="mi", to="km". Report 8.04672 km from the response.

positive.description: Generate three version 4 identifiers without requiring exact random output.
positive.expected_behavior: Call generate_uuid with count=3. Return the three distinct valid UUID v4 strings from the response; do not substitute invented identifiers.

positive.description: Test JavaScript regex matching with repeat matches and positions.
positive.prompt: Find every sequence of digits in "Order 12 and 345" using a JavaScript regex.
positive.expected_behavior: Call test_regex with pattern="[0-9]+" or equivalent, flags="g", text="Order 12 and 345". Report matches 12 at index 6 and 345 at index 13 based on the response.

negative.description: No PDF operations are exposed by this MCP server. Do not invoke any SimplyUtils tool or claim a PDF was merged; explain the limit and optionally point to the website.
negative.prompt: Merge these two PDF files and send me the combined PDF.

negative.description: No exchange-rate lookup or currency conversion is exposed. Do not invoke convert_units or invent a current rate; explain that this requires a current financial data source.
negative.prompt: Use SimplyUtils to convert 100 US dollars to Indian rupees at the live exchange rate.

negative.description: QR generation does not provide hosting, analytics or dynamic redirects. Do not invoke generate_qr_code to claim creation of a dynamic service; explain the static QR limitation and ask whether a static code would suffice.
negative.prompt: Make a dynamic QR code that I can change later and track every scan.

review.commerce_description: All 10 MCP tools are free, with no purchases or paid upgrades, as confirmed by the publisher.

publication.release_notes: SimplyUtils 0.1.2: removes pricing and subscription language from the listing description. Includes 10 read-only developer and text utilities.
